phrases.latin: Tum in soliō aquā calidā lavātus est nāviculā lūdēns
phrases.english: Then he had his bath in hot water, playing with his little boat

phrases.latin: Nāviculam ex chartā faciāmus et in lacūnam dēmittāmus.
phrases.english: Let’s make a paper boat and put it in the puddle.

sources: Lewis & Short: navicula · Lewis & Short: chartaceus
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
